subject.title: [Feature]: Add a safe Cursor onboarding inference route

question: Should OpenClaw formally keep Cursor automatic onboarding inference deferred until Cursor documents and supports the proposed tool-free, owner-verifiable probe contract?
rationale: This is a new onboarding/provider capability with a security-sensitive boundary; source context does not establish that a safe existing Cursor API is available or that OpenClaw should sponsor a vendor-contract dependency.

options.title: Defer until vendor contract exists
options.body: Record the required CLI guarantees and keep Cursor limited to its existing whole-agent/ACP integration until they are available.

options.title: Sponsor a narrower discovery-only path
options.body: Permit installed/authenticated Cursor discovery in onboarding while continuing to require manual user selection and never infer or persist a route automatically.

options.title: Accept a documented weaker contract
options.body: Approve a specific reduced-safety design only after maintainers define the allowed tool, owner-binding, and upgrade guarantees.

recommendation.title: Defer until vendor contract exists
recommendation.body: Record the required CLI guarantees and keep Cursor limited to its existing whole-agent/ACP integration until they are available.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the requested contract and related onboarding direction; broader ownership should be confirmed from the affected code history before implementation.
